name: Flipside
description: Runs a SQL query on Flipside's blockchain data tables through the Flipside API and writes every page of the result. Flipside has wound down its public query tools, so the API may no longer accept queries.
introductoryText:
![Flipside](data:image/png;base64,)

Runs a **SQL query** on Flipside's blockchain data tables through the Flipside API, waits for it (up to 20 minutes), and writes every page of the result.

**Service status:** Flipside closed its free Studio in July 2025, sold its blockchain data business in May 2026 and archived its software development kit (which this block uses) in July 2026. The API may no longer accept queries; see the block's README.

**How to set it up**
1. Enter your Flipside API key.
2. Enter the SQL query (Flipside's tables, such as `ethereum.core.fact_transactions`).
3. Run the block. A fresh result is computed on every run.
